dct_description_sm: Iraq administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 18 Governorate - Admin 2: 101 District - Admin 3: 294 Sub-district Dates associated with this dataset: - 19 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 03 June 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 05 June 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 05 June 2019: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
